title.purpose: Pet names and prominent card titles.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Color, border, transform, and shadow state transitions; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action on cream and paper surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:44px; padding:11px 16px; border:1px solid var(--brand, #18251d); border-radius:10px; background:var(--brand, #18251d); color:var(--on-brand, #ffffff); font:700 16px/20px "Source Sans 3",Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--brand-hover, #233b29); transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgba(24,37,29,.13); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #b7ff72); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Hero Button
components.description: Lime call to action on the deep green hero.
components.css: .ds-hero-surface { display:inline-block; padding:20px; border-radius:16px; background:var(--hero, #18251d); } .ds-btn-hero { min-height:44px; padding:11px 16px; border:1px solid var(--lime, #b7ff72); border-radius:10px; background:var(--lime, #b7ff72); color:var(--dark-ink, #18251d); font:700 16px/20px "Source Sans 3",Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-hero:hover { background:#ffffff; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-hero:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #b7ff72); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action for forms and repeated record controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height:44px; padding:11px 16px; border:1px solid var(--ink, #18251d); border-radius:10px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #18251d); font:700 16px/20px "Source Sans 3",Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:var(--brand-soft, #dceac9); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #b7ff72); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Service Navigation
components.description: Green service bar with a lime active destination.
components.html: Adopt a petPet care
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:9px 12px; border-radius:12px; background:var(--hero, #18251d); } .ds-nav-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:40px; padding:9px 14px; border-radius:9px; color:var(--hero-ink, #fff9e9); font:600 14px/20px "Source Sans 3",Arial,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 180ms ease,color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background:rgba(183,255,114,.13); color:var(--lime, #b7ff72); } .ds-nav-active { background:var(--lime, #b7ff72); color:var(--dark-ink, #18251d); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #b7ff72); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Labeled Field
components.description: Paper input with a visible label and lime keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:var(--ink, #18251d); font:500 16px/22px "Source Sans 3",Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; min-height:46px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--line, #cbd5bd); border-radius:10px; background:var(--paper, #fffdf5); color:var(--ink, #18251d); font:400 18px/26px "Source Sans 3",Arial,sans-serif; caret-color:var(--brand, #18251d); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#5e6b61; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #b7ff72); outline-offset:0; border-color:var(--brand, #18251d); }

components.name: Pet Listing Card
components.description: Image-led adoption card; the preview shows the product's missing-photo fallback.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-pet-card { width:230px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:16px; background:var(--paper, #fffdf5); color:var(--ink, #18251d); box-shadow:0 9px 22px rgba(24,37,29,.08); font-family:"Source Sans 3",Arial,sans-serif; transition:transform 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-pet-card:hover,.ds-pet-card:focus-within { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 16px 28px rgba(24,37,29,.14); } .ds-pet-photo { display:grid; place-items:center; width:100%; aspect-ratio:4/3; background:var(--brand-soft, #dceac9); color:#526455; font:400 14px/20px "Source Sans 3",Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-pet-body { display:grid; gap:8px; padding:20px; } .ds-pet-body h3 { margin:0; font:800 1.55rem/1.18 Fraunces,Georgia,serif; } .ds-pet-body p { margin:0; font-size:14px; } .ds-pet-body a { color:var(--brand, #18251d); font-weight:600; text-underline-offset:.22em; } .ds-pet-body a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #b7ff72); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Source Chip
components.description: Small textual source or status marker on a soft sage surface.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--brand-soft, #dceac9); color:var(--brand, #18251d); font:400 14px/20px "Source Sans 3",Arial,sans-serif; }

components.name: Office Table
components.description: Compact review data with a sage heading and alternating rows.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x:auto; border:1px solid var(--line, #cbd5bd); border-radius:12px; background:var(--paper, #fffdf5); } .ds-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; color:var(--ink, #18251d); font:400 14px/20px "Source Sans 3",Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-table th,.ds-table td { padding:12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #cbd5bd); text-align:left; } .ds-table th { background:var(--brand-soft, #dceac9); font-weight:600; } .ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background:var(--canvas-wash, #edf3dc); }

narrative.overview:
PawsLink makes the path from pet registration to approved adoption feel welcoming and clear. Warm cream surrounds deep green navigation and feature panels. Lime marks the next useful action. Real pet photographs supply warmth and individuality, especially in the large right-side home and learning heroes and the adoption cards.

The public experience has generous spacing, oversized Fraunces headlines, and playful rounded cards. Owner, veterinarian, and CAVD screens use the same colors and type with tighter rows, forms, filters, and tables so work remains easy to scan. The default is light; the existing theme control offers a dark variant. CAVD and capstone identification remain visible without making the visual world look like a paper form.
keyCharacteristics: A cream ground with a contiguous deep green header, navigation, prototype strip, and home hero.
Lime action and active-navigation highlights paired with deep green text.
Prominent real animal photography, serif display type, and softly rounded cards.
Coordinated, denser task layouts for owner, veterinary, and office workflows.

rules.name: The Two-Color Anchor Rule
rules.body: Keep Shelter Green (#18251d) and Action Lime (#b7ff72) exact. Supporting colors may distinguish surfaces and feedback states, but must not replace either anchor.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Fraunces for expressive headings and Source Sans 3 for task content. Reserve monospace for values that benefit from fixed-width scanning.

rules.name: The Density Follows Task Rule
rules.body: Give discovery and learning generous space; keep review queues, forms, and records compact enough to scan without losing the shared palette or type.

rules.name: The Quiet Work Surface Rule
rules.body: Use paper and borders for staff content. Save lifted shadows for cards that invite exploration or selection.

dos: Do keep all existing routes, forms, validation, permissions, review actions, and Supabase behavior while extending this visual system.
Do use real project pet photography and the text fallback when an image is unavailable.
Do keep the skip link, semantic navigation and tables, labelled fields, visible keyboard focus, textual status, and reduced-motion treatment.
Do retain CAVD and capstone identification and the existing public-record privacy boundary.
donts: Don't revive the old white-paper municipal styling, square listing cards, IBM Plex/Source Serif pairing, or tiny forest-green accents as the default look.
Don't treat a match as an approval or expose owner contact details on public records.
Don't replace the exact green and lime anchors, cover pet photographs with chips or copy, or fabricate a photo when one is missing.
